name: a-loop
mode: image-to-video from site/assets/plates/business.webp, fit pad to 16:9, ending on the first frame again (a seamless loop)
prompt: Exactly as in the image: a handmade miniature diorama of an Indian snack business seen from above in soft morning light, a pale factory with two brick chimneys and a small office at the left, a corrugated godown warehouse full of brown cartons in the middle, a lane of colourful kirana shops at the right, a highway climbing to a small warehouse on a hill at the back right, a community kitchen with a blue awning at the back, a fenced dump yard at the back left, and a thin softly glowing green path painted along the road. Over the clip the business works: the tiny yellow forklift carries a carton out of the godown and across the forecourt, the two workers at the table by the godown lift a carton between them, the small blue truck at the factory's loading bay pulls away along the road toward the godown and stops at its gate, tiny shoppers walk along the kirana lane and reach for packets at the shop fronts, the green auto-rickshaw drives slowly past the shops, the white van drives up the highway to the warehouse on the hill, and people at the community kitchen move about. The thin glowing green path stays exactly where it is painted on the road, glowing steadily, and never moves onto any building. By the end of the clip every vehicle and person has returned to exactly where it began, so the clip loops seamlessly. Every building stays exactly where it is, with the same shape, size and colours; nothing new appears; no text appears anywhere. Locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Soft even morning daylight, no lens flare.
encode: ffmpeg -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -crf 25 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart (from LTX's own H.264)
use: the hero film by day, SC-78 part 1 option A: one ten-second take that loops without a cut
attempts: two: the first (seed 7831) let the glowing path leave the road and trace the godown's roof for about three seconds; this one tells the path to stay on the road, glowing steadily
